title: CyclOT: Learning Quadratic Optimal Transport Maps via Synchronized Forward-Backward Interpolants
abstract: arXiv:2609.13892v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the recovery of forward and reverse quadratic optimal-transport maps from unpaired samples in high dimensions. We introduce a bidirectional neural framework in which the learned maps induce forward and backward displacement interpolants, while the training objective combines bidirectional quadratic action, discriminator-restricted Jensen-Shannon endpoint objectives, and two-sided cycle consistency. The construction requires neither precomputed sample pairings nor an explicit convex-potential parameterization. For absolutely continuous probability measures supported on a compact convex set, and under the stated generator-approximation, discriminator-richness, and minimizer-attainment conditions, we prove a population recovery theorem: for every prescribed accuracy, the sum of the corresponding \(L^2\) errors between any global minimizer and the forward and reverse quadratic Brenier maps is below that accuracy, provided the disc

translated_title: CyclOT：通过同步的前向-后向插值学习二次最优传输映射
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何从高维非配对样本中恢复前向和反向的二次最优传输映射。我们引入了一个双向神经框架，其中学习到的映射可诱导前向和后向位移插值，同时训练目标结合了双向二次作用量、受判别器限制的Jensen-Shannon端点目标以及双向循环一致性。该构造既不需要预先计算的样本配对，也不需要显式的凸势参数化。对于支撑在紧凸集上的绝对连续概率测度，并在所述的生成器近似、判别器丰富性以及极小值达成条件下，我们证明了一个总体恢复定理：对于任意给定的精度，任意全局极小值点与前向和反向二次Brenier映射之间对应的L²误差之和均低于该精度，前提是判别器……
tldr: 该论文提出CyclOT双向神经框架，利用同步的前向-后向插值从非配对样本中学习二次最优传输映射，无需预计算样本配对或显式凸势参数化，并在一定条件下证明了任意全局极小值点与真实Brenier映射之间L²误差之和可任意小的总体恢复定理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes CyclOT, a bidirectional neural framework that learns quadratic optimal transport maps from unpaired samples via synchronized forward-backward interpolants, requiring neither precomputed pairings nor explicit convex-potential parameterization, and proves a population recovery theorem guaranteeing that the summed L² errors of any global minimizer to the true forward and reverse Brenier maps can be made arbitrarily small.
